scene: The machine rattles loudly and drops a glowing teal capsule into the chute.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a tiled platform. On the far left sits the red capsule machine with a glowing teal ball in its chute. Left stands the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man with top knot and ukulele, watching it. Centre sits the clanking ramen robot at its counter. Far right looms the waving golden cat.
shown: a glowing teal plastic capsule sitting in the open dispenser chute on the left
a mechanical ramen chef chopping scallions behind a steaming steel counter in the centre
a towering golden cat statue with a swing-out harness on the far right
